phone: Choose a background for your Android phone or iPhone home and lock screens; cropping may be needed.
fold: Choose backgrounds for foldable phone screens; crop each image to fit the inner or outer display.
pad: Choose a background for iPad or Android tablets; match the image orientation to your screen.
desktop: Choose a desktop background for your PC or Mac; crop to fit your display.
generic: Preview the original images and choose a background that fits your screen.
live: Video playback and wallpaper support depend on your device and wallpaper app.
themeMetaDescription: Download {count} selected {title}. Check original resolutions, preview images and find more stock wallpapers from each source collection.
previewNote: Open an image to preview it and download the original. Portrait images suit phone screens; landscape images suit PC and Mac displays. Check the listed dimensions and crop as needed. Each source link opens the full original collection.

themeDescriptions.dark: Deep backgrounds, subdued light and dark abstract forms from stock wallpaper collections. Compare the shadows and details before choosing a background for your screen.
themeDescriptions.gradient: Smooth color transitions from phone and desktop stock collections. Explore soft pastel blends, richer color fields and flowing gradients, with original dimensions shown on every image.
themeDescriptions.minimal_geometric: Simple geometric shapes with room for your icons. This selection focuses on pared-back circles, planes and lines rather than busy patterns or detailed scenes.
themeDescriptions.anime: Anime-style characters and illustrated scenes found in stock wallpaper collections. Browse the artwork, check the original dimensions and follow each source to explore its complete collection.
themeDescriptions.abstract: Sculptural forms, fluid surfaces and expressive color from original stock collections. Explore abstract images chosen for their composition and the way they work behind home-screen icons.
themeDescriptions.nature: Mountains, coastlines and quiet natural scenes from phone and desktop collections. Match the landscape or portrait composition to your display and download the original image from the preview.
themeDescriptions.photography: Photographic stock wallpapers featuring real places, textures and details. Compare subjects and lighting, then check each image’s orientation and original size before setting it as your background.
themeDescriptions.floral: Flowers, foliage and petal-inspired compositions from stock wallpaper collections. The selection brings together botanical photographs and stylized floral forms, with links to their original device collections.
themeDescriptions.technology: Mechanical detail, digital forms and futuristic scenes from existing stock collections. Choose a technology-inspired background by its composition and original dimensions, rather than by device brand alone.
themeDescriptions.illustration: Drawn landscapes, graphic scenes and playful illustrations from stock collections. Explore different drawing styles and follow the source links to find more images from the same collection.
